question_templates.authority_change: Does transition {transition_id} support the proposed authority scope without exceeding the bounded evidence?
question_templates.changed_runtime_dependency: Do changed runtime dependencies in {transition_id} preserve the qualification-supporting assumptions and claim boundary?
question_templates.inheritance_boundary_change: Can inherited evidence in {transition_id} cross the changed dependency boundary, and on what compatibility basis?
question_templates.evidence_condition: What is the bounded meaning of the contradictory, incomplete, anomalous, or warning-bearing evidence in {transition_id}?
question_templates.limitations_or_no_claims: How do the limitations or no-claims language in {transition_id} constrain acceptance, inheritance, and authority?
question_templates.irreversible_decision: Does the evidence justify the irreversible publication, integration, or acceptance decision in {transition_id}?
question_templates.mechanical_warning: Does warning-bearing mechanical evidence change the bounded meaning, limitations, inheritance, or authority decision?
